The explicit complete-history joint finite-density kernel/product integration is attributed ASTIS source-implicit completion. No implementation may retroactively define author topology.
source_math.objects_and_domains: Complete tagged finite history at fixed deterministic depth; actual next unused raw clock n; prospective time s strictly between0 and finite d(h); finite Lebesgue-density submeasure, not a normalized next-event distribution.
source_math.quantifiers: All deterministic y,r,z0,n, all fixed Borel history functions d with finite nonnegative values, all joint Borel nonnegative extended F and all Borel history events A. d(H_n) may be random; d has no external omega/tail argument. Arbitrary extended F may have infinite integral.
source_math.density: rho(h,s)=lambda(Phi_s z)exp(-Lambda_z(s)) for live last state and s>0; stopped density0. The full-line extension using Lambda(toNNReal s) is auxiliary only; guarded D=1_(0<s<d(h))*rho eliminates all s<=0 and out-of-cutoff values.
source_math.finite_kernel: Borel finite subprobability kernel K_d(h,ds)=D(h,s)ds, for every h including unrealizable histories. Bound total mass<=1, never rho<=1 or finite weighted integrals for unbounded F.
source_math.actual_observable: Only the restricted event of a live strict-positive finite next wait is evaluated. A zero-valued total wait/time extraction outside the finite guard is an observable encoding; stopped/infinity values do not become actual waits or phases.
source_math.kernel_constructor_risk: Kernel.withDensity has a zero fallback for a nonmeasurable density. A faithful implementation must derive joint D measurability and explicitly identify every K_d(h) with volume.withDensity(D h), not rely on kernel typing or its fallback.
source_math.reference_measure: Exactly real Lebesgue used by the deterministic finite-density producer. It is equivalent to the positive NNReal trace by inclusion/toNNReal inverse on s>0, with no rescaling. Ioc-to-Ioo uses measure restriction rather than probability endpoint substitution.
source_math.conditioning: Unnormalized restricted probability/lintegral identity. Null A allowed; no point-history division or regular conditional distribution representative. Missing mass beyond d or infinity is retained outside the finite submeasure.
source_math.consumer: Joint F permits future composition with the Borel finite append/update constructor, and d_T(h)=max(T-last_time,0) imposes the next ordered event cutoff. Constructing a complete iteration/final path factor remains separate.
